requirements.title: SHIFTA argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer; SHIFT shall be integer, nonnegative, and no greater than BIT_SIZE(I).

pending.SHIFTA-I-integer: Positive source control calls SHIFTA with integer I containing distinguished low and leftmost bits; source-control mutation uses noninteger I and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SHIFTA-SHIFT-integer: Positive source controls call SHIFTA with integer SHIFT values 0, 1, and BIT_SIZE(I); source-control mutation uses noninteger SHIFT and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SHIFTA-SHIFT-nonnegative-and-at-most-bit: Positive source controls call SHIFTA with SHIFT=0, SHIFT=1, and SHIFT=BIT_SIZE(I); source-control mutations use -1 and BIT_SIZE(I)+1 and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: SHIFTA arithmetic right-shift bit result
requirements.definition: The SHIFTA result is formed by shifting I right by SHIFT bits, filling the left SHIFT bits with copies of the original leftmost bit, preserving I for zero SHIFT, and losing bits shifted out on the right.

pending.SHIFTA-right-shift-bits: Use I with bit positions 4 and 6 set and leftmost bit clear, SHIFT=2, and BTEST observations showing bits 2 and 4 set; add nonzero I=IBSET(0,0), SHIFT=BIT_SIZE(I), and assert POPCNT(SHIFTA(I,BIT_SIZE(I)))==0 in bit context; mutate SHIFT to 1.
pending.SHIFTA-left-fill-replicates-leftmost-bit: Use I with the leftmost bit set and SHIFT=2; assert BTEST of the two leftmost result bits is true. Add I=IBSET(0,BIT_SIZE(0)-1), SHIFT=BIT_SIZE(I), assert POPCNT(SHIFTA(I,BIT_SIZE(I)))==BIT_SIZE(I), and compare only bit-context observations; mutate I to clear the original leftmost bit.
pending.SHIFTA-zero-shift-preserves-bits: Use I with bits 0, 3, and BIT_SIZE(I)-1 set, SHIFT=0, and assert selected BTEST results plus POPCNT match I exactly; companion SHIFT=1 avoids a vacuous unchanged check.
pending.SHIFTA-right-shifted-bits-lost: Use I with only bit 0 set, SHIFT=1, and assert POPCNT of the result is 0 with a nonzero companion; include SHIFT=BIT_SIZE(I) on the same nonzero leftmost-clear I and assert POPCNT is 0, then mutate SHIFT to 0.
